prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
[goal] Make fast-coder's context window 262144 in OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs, durably.

[action] The three files in `out/` are generated by `gen.py` from `models.json`, so I fixed the source. In `models.json` I changed fast-coder `context_window` from 131072 to 262144, then ran `python gen.py`. I did not hand-edit `out/`, because the next regeneration would have reverted that. I removed my scratch `tmp/` afterwards.

[result]
- `out/opencode.json` already had 262144, so it was unchanged.
- `out/claude.json`: `contextWindow` went from 131072 to 262144.
- `out/codex.toml`: `context_window` went from 131072 to 262144.
- I diffed `out/` before and after regeneration. Those two lines were the only differences, so no other model setting changed.
- `grep 131072` over the folder finds nothing left.
- The brief didn't say how the install step copies files into each harness. I assumed it runs after `gen.py` and I did not run it. The live harness configs on the workstation will not change until you run it.

[next] Run the install step so the harnesses pick up the new files.
